crossRefs.note: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on…
When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
Shall it be said, O house of Jacob: “Is Yahweh’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who…
For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how…

translations.web: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
translations.bsb: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.
translations.kjv: Ye are ➔ not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
translations.asv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own affections.
